key_points_missing: Partial only, not missing in substance: key point 5 expects 'MyStandards XSDs' to be named as a missing production item; the term MyStandards does not occur anywhere in this bundle, and the answer instead names the T2S XSD / production XSD and the T2S message identity (name, version, acknowledgements) as not in reviewed evidence (Section 3B, 3D closing note, 8.3). The Standard for X-TRM Users VER.01.09 (per ON_20/2026) and the reason-code catalogue are named and labelled unresolved/blocked as expected.

citation_problems.citation: Acceptance criterion 7.8, tied to [[milan-xtrm-lifecycle]] §3.4.7 A, PDF 45-46
citation_problems.problem: Compresses two distinct rules into one: the passage says changes outside the T2S User Requirements cases 'must be performed by deleting and re-entering it', while modification requests against settled/cancelled/CoSD instructions are (per the double-negative acceptance condition) simply not accepted; the passage does not say the latter are 'handled by delete-and-re-enter'. Section 5.3 of the answer states both rules correctly and 7.8 defers to it, so this is a summary-row imprecision rather than a mis-cited source; it does not change the dimension score.
citation_problems.passage_quote: Instructions of modification are accepted and processed unless: settlement instruction that must be modified is not already settled or canceled; settlement instruction that must be modified is not identified as ''CoSD'' ... Outside of the cases identified by the T2S User Requirements, any other changes of the settlement Instructions must be performed by deleting and re-entering it by the X-TRM Participant.

unsupported_claims: Process-level, disclosed as non-evidence: rows 4.7, 8.10 and open item 4 state that Milan participant cut-offs are 'blocked in the library's routing index (gap G01)'; only gap G03 appears in this bundle. The answer itself labels this 'a handling fact, not evidence', and no cut-off time is asserted, so it is not an operational claim.

Scope block row (d) says the agent 'does not treat the June 2025 Instructions' printed night-time schedule as current'; no such schedule is in the bundle (only 'before the starting of the night-time settlement phase' appears). It is a refusal labelled reasoned inference, not an assertion, and nothing is built on it.
reason: The answer delivers the supportable functional specification and abstains exactly where the bundle stops: it grounds the connectivity model in §1.1.1 ('model of indirect connectivity (Participants ICP): using the system for connection to the T2S platform of Monte Titoli whose features are regulated under the X-TRM Service Rules'), reproduces the §3.3 access-method table and Table 2 exactly as transcribed (RNI M.S. G52/G53, RNI F.T. and FileAct G50/G51/G56, FIN MT540-MT543/MT548/MT598, RNI M.S. G57/G58; 'mandatory 13, additional 2, optional 4' with default 'NO' except Trade Date 'Date of release of the contract in X-TRM' and the blank Settlement Date cell), preserves both truncated cells and the unlocated footnote, and carries the LIMITATION 'Functional correspondence only: not the A2A/RNI message layouts, not a T2S XSD' on every row, so neither fail condition (inventing layouts/cardinalities/reason codes; presenting the mapping as the production layout) is triggered. The blocked retrieval is disclosed verbatim ('Current production X-TRM standard and service entitlements required; future notice is not a payload specification', gap G03), the lifecycle steps quote §§3.4.2-3.4.8 accurately (including the double-negative modification condition, flagged as a source anomaly and labelled reasoned inference), the T2S status model stays within §1.6.3.1.1-1.6.3.1.3 with the LIMITATION that transition diagrams and reason codes are not admitted, and every Milan citation carries 'Italian text prevails', the 30 June 2025 (MN_10/2025) or 26 January 2026 edition, the correct PDF/printed page and the correct review date (13 September for the Regulations and the T2S source, 14 September for the Instructions sections). No clock time beyond the printed '4 p.m.', no message version, no fee amount and no status value is invented; the only blemishes are a compressed acceptance-criterion row (7.8) and two process-level remarks (gap G01, a night-time schedule) that are disclosed as non-evidence.
